notes.title: Small debug patch
notes.notes: No meaningful changes made, just added debug code to improve my chances to find a crash I've been searching for a while.

notes.title: Patch #16 : Release candidate... probably.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36669583/ba36b8811df105f89f9f7a5c6ec0f8b3d87dc113.png[/img]

This it the first version with all the projected features implemented and a release candidate for the full release. In this update:

[list]
[*] Added the last achievements, including the Very hard + no flee one. This is a quite tough achievement for people who really like challenges.
[*] Now when you're using a Phoenix Hair, the timebar updates so that you know when the revived character's next turn will be.
[*] Fixed the poison damage amount, which was incorrectly calculated when waiting.
[*] Several memory optimizations and hiccup reduction.
[*] A few world map features wouldn't show a message in order for the player to know they could enter a new map by pressing the action button. Now they have it.
[*] Fixed a few bugs related to cutscene skipping.
[*] Sometimes some characters would get in the middle of the camera when doing an unite. Fixed.
[*] Sometimes some characters would get in the middle of the camera when watching an enemy's stats. Fixed.
[*] Fixed some problems when retrying battles.
[/list]

From now on my focus will be on fixing bugs and improving the performance of the game. 

I'm considering moving the game to NetCore to further improve performance, as I'm not very happy with some aspects of the game (specially some hiccups that have proved very hard to fix).
If I decide to do the move a big round of testing will be needed again, however if the NetCore version does not significatively improve the problems I'm trying to avoid, this version is a release candidate.

Thanks for your understanding and support!

notes.title: Update notes 15 Oct 2021
notes.notes:
Maintenance update, mostly devoted to fix small bugs and improve performance. 
[list]
[*] Several files are now preloaded and cached, reducing hiccups a lot.
[*] Changed compression method to reduce loading times.
[*] More teleport points added for teleport talisman.
[*] No more dupped spells in the magic casting menu.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes 18 Sep 2021
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Now you have the same MP and same initial turn order when retrying a battle.
[*] Some prize locations have been changed to improve playability (Unlock Lev.2 has been moved to a way easier place now)
[*] Several small changes and bugfixes :
  [list]
  [*] Entering menu while walking instantly moved the selected menu item.
  [*] Stray sound being played when characters were talking fixed.
  [*] Some doors did not make the correct sound.
  [*] Minigame score calculation fixed.
  [*] retry+autosave bug fixed
  [*] Message added to a minigame host to make obvious that prizes are given.
  [*] FastNoise license was missing.
  [*] Some exits have been made easier to use.
  [*] Slightly toned down some enemies on Normal difficulty mode.
  [/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Update notes for 11 Sept 2021
notes.notes:
* You can now [b]Retry[/b] a battle if you lose it. 
* You can lower difficulty for the length of that retried battle only.
* You can also reconfigure your formation and equipment before the battle retry.

* The (c)orb menus now display help making it easier to understand how you're setting up your characters.

* Gameplay adjustments and several extra cutscenes added.
* (fixed) Information messages stopped displaying when dying in a battle and then reloading.

notes.title: Update Notes 04 Sept 2021
notes.notes:
* [b]Hint system added.[/b] Hold the left shoulder or keyboard key '1' (can be redefined) to bring up a help message about the Main Quest. Hints are as spoilerless as possible.

* [b]Items can now be sorted[/b] in the items menu.
* Improved some tutorials and fixed some cutscenes.
* Equipment sort by stat fixed.

notes.title: Update Notes 31 Aug 2021
notes.notes:
Bugfixes and technical changes:
* Several fixes and improvements in the final dungeon.
* Some fixes and features added to a minigame.
* A set of wild butterflies had escaped from the map and have been returned to their rightful place.

Gameplay changes:
* You can rest and buy items at Tanne's house now.
* Some item prices have been adjusted.
* A few new scenes added to clarify some backstories.

notes.title: Update Notes for 27 Aug 2021
notes.notes:
Bugfixes and technical changes:
* Keyboard can now be redefined in the main screen, some default keybindings have been changed.
* Keyboard settings weren't correctly saved (fixed).
* Thumbstick rebound fix.
* Improved memory usage.


Gameplay changes:
* Chests have now different colors depending on the chest level.
* Equipment sets now gives you extra bonuses when worn.
* Changed some debris location to make passage easier in some maps.
* Escape bomb added, it allows you to quickly escape from enemies. Available in most stores in your area.
* Eyedrops didn't work correctly. (fixed)

notes.title: Update Notes for 22 Aug 2021
notes.notes:
Game fixes:
* Huge bug fixed which caused more havok than Hikaru in a mirror shop when leaving to the main menu and reloading a game.
* Mouse camera movement improved on low framerate.
* UI on resolutions higher than 1080p is no longer small and confined to the center of the screen
* Some bugs fixed on widescreen resolutions.
* Menu characters are now displayed in native resolution.

Gameplay changes:
* You no longer lose money when you flee.
* Two recruitable characters now have their own model instead of having a generic one.

notes.title: Update notes, 20 Aug 2021
notes.notes: * Fixed a freeze with a dialog when playing with low framerate.

notes.title: Update notes, 18 Aug 2021
notes.notes:
* Fixed potential crash in a certain battle and several bugs in that same battle.
* Made the control configuration clearer.
* Several improvements to make the game more fluid.
* Fixed bug which prevented some players to start the game (missing Steamworks dependency).

notes.title: First round of bug fixes
notes.notes:
* Fixed a bug that didn't let you see correctly the mana you had in battle.
* Fixed some bugs in resolutions larger than 1080p. Menus will still look small, but I hope to address that problem in a next update.
* Adjusted some sfx audio levels.
* Fixed some typos.
* Horizontal and vertical camera speeds can now be configured separately
* Increased gamepad dead zone.
* Fixed a crash when checking the enemy data while in battle.

notes.title: Castle of the Underdogs E.A. release date announced.
notes.notes:
Hello!

The release date of Castle of the Underdogs Ep.1 Early Access has been set: August, 14th 2021.  
I've also released an Early Access trailer.

[previewyoutube=52m8NHA1llA;full][/previewyoutube]

The Early Access version will be fully featured, very close to the final version. I plan to stay on Early Access for a few months, while adding some extra features, trophies, improving usability, adjusting difficulty and fixing bugs.

Please wishlist if you still haven't!
